declarations.state_ownership: No tables: no migration creates a tarot table (grep -i tarot in lobster-factory/packages/db/migrations finds only comments and the 0110 product_key check). Batch jobs live in an in-process Map (lib/tarot/batch-store.ts:1-5) and the daily quota is an in-process counter (lib/tarot/quota.ts:1-16); both are lost on restart. Batch images go to the customer's R2 at tarot-batch/<jobId>/<index>.png (app/api/internal/tarot/batch/[jobId]/card/route.ts:77-78), a data URL in memory without R2 (:88-89). Single generations return to the browser; saving goes through design's /api/tools/designs. Cost rows go to the platform table ai_call_logs (lib/ai/log-ai-call.ts:111).
declarations.behavior_ownership: Text and image-to-image tarot generation across many models (lib/tarot/image-gen.ts; app/api/tools/tarot/generate/route.ts), style-prompt suggestion (suggest-prompt/route.ts), the 78-card background batch (batch/route.ts, batch/[jobId]/route.ts, app/api/internal/tarot/batch/[jobId]/{start,card}/route.ts, Trigger task tarot-batch-generate). lib/tarot/image-gen.ts is also the shared engine of studio (lib/studio/image-provider.ts:29), content (app/api/content/image/route.ts:230) and video (lib/content/blocks/video-pipeline.ts:362); each caller passes its own grant (image-gen.ts:603). lib/tarot/video-motion-gen.ts is used only by video (video.motion, video-pipeline.ts:412); tarot has no motion feature.
declarations.public_api_event_contract: HTTP POST /api/tools/tarot/generate; POST /api/tools/tarot/suggest-prompt (withFeature("tarot.prompt"), suggest-prompt/route.ts:29); POST|GET /api/tools/tarot/batch; GET /api/tools/tarot/batch/[jobId]. The batch route starts the Trigger task through REST POST <TRIGGER_API_URL>/api/v1/tasks/tarot-batch-generate/trigger (batch/route.ts:53-71; the job is created before the run, :54); the task calls back POST /api/internal/tarot/batch/[jobId]/start and .../card with Bearer BATCH_INTERNAL_SECRET from its own env (packages/workflows/src/trigger/tarot-batch-generate.ts:44-47). Outbound: Replicate and OpenAI images (image-gen.ts:406, :540), Anthropic (suggest-prompt/route.ts:48), R2.
declarations.invariants: At most 78 cards per batch (batch/route.ts:41-43). A global daily image cap TAROT_DAILY_LIMIT, default 300, resetting at UTC midnight, is checked before every generation (quota.ts:4, :15-16; tarot/generate/route.ts:89; card/route.ts:58-61); a card refused by the quota aborts the rest of the batch (tarot-batch-generate.ts:120-124). At most 2 concurrent batch runs, 90 minutes each, never retried as a whole (tarot-batch-generate.ts:36-41). The /api/tools/tarot routes require owner/admin/operator (canCreateAiImageJob, lib/ops-role.ts:68-70); the /api/internal/tarot callbacks require BATCH_INTERNAL_SECRET, compared in constant time, and refuse when it is unset (card/route.ts:20-25). Tarot images ask tarot.image (tarot/generate/route.ts:38; app/api/internal/tarot/batch/[jobId]/card/route.ts:64) and pass the grant to the engine (image-gen.ts:603).
declarations.dependencies: next-admin with Supabase for login sessions (middleware.ts:2, :362) and cost logging (lib/ai/log-ai-call.ts:111); trigger (tarot-batch-generate); Replicate, OpenAI, Anthropic; R2 (lib/storage/r2.ts:30-37). No tarot table in Supabase. products.ts dependsOn is empty. Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row tarot.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: Generation errors return HTTP 200 with ok:false so nginx does not replace the body (tarot/generate/route.ts:113-116); a failed card is counted and the batch continues after one retry, while a 401/404 refusal from next-admin fails the run (tarot-batch-generate.ts:58-69, :74-138); an R2 failure falls back to the public URL or a data URL (card/route.ts:74-89); missing Trigger configuration returns 503 (batch/route.ts:19-26). The task's callbacks use /api/internal/tarot/*, outside the session middleware (matcher middleware.ts:413); lib/__tests__/trigger-callbacks-server-to-server.test.ts keeps every Trigger callback there.
declarations.data_lifecycle: Job and quota state disappear on process restart (batch-store.ts:2-4, quota.ts:1-4); the job Map is never pruned, reads are capped at 10 (batch-store.ts:90-94). R2 tarot-batch/ objects are not deleted by tarot code (grep delete in lib/tarot and app/api/tools/tarot: none).
declarations.observability_contract: logImageCost (tool tarot) runs when the caller passes a job id (tarot/generate/route.ts:107-110); the card route logs no cost; suggest-prompt logs through logAiCall (suggest-prompt/route.ts:66); the Trigger run logs each card (tarot-batch-generate.ts:74-138). Job status exists only in memory through GET /batch and /batch/[jobId]; there is no persistent audit trail.
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: No migrations, nothing to roll back. batch-store.ts:4 proposes a tarot_batch_jobs table that does not exist.
declarations.replacement_strategy: The model registry and transports are in lib/tarot/image-gen.ts; studio consumes it through a facade (lib/studio/image-provider.ts:1-7) and content and video import it directly, so replacing the engine affects those products too. The batch store is a small module (batch-store.ts:31-94) that a durable store can replace without route changes.
